news.title: Tel Aviv University professor convicted of sexual harassment, suspended from supervising Ph.D. students
news.summary: The emeritus professor was also reprimanded and barred from conferences and research grants; the university tribunal declined to publish his name despite requests from complainants

news.title: WATCH: Israel Police arrest 50 suspected of extorting contractors under guise of security services
news.summary: Some 500 officers raided targets across Israel on Monday, arresting 50 suspected of extorting contractors under the guise of security services, including a sitting council head in the North.

news.title: Both Israeli teams struggle in Euroleague
news.summary: Hapoel Tel Aviv fell to Barcelona, while Maccabi Tel Aviv was defeated by Partizan Belgrade ahead of the derby.

news.title: Tel Aviv man accused of stealing from yeshiva, denies recognizing himself in footage
news.summary: Roy Cohen, a Tel Aviv resident in his 40s with 14 previous convictions, allegedly broke into a yeshiva on Rothschild Boulevard and stole tefillin worth NIS 25,000, cash, and other valuables.
